claims.disproof_condition: 條件：Freiberger 官網撤下 InP 晶圓產品、或公司公告退出 InP 基板業務。核查頻率：每半年（官網產品頁）。觸發後 48 小時：e1 提撤回、重讀 InP 基板層（mat:inp_substrate）的供給側列舉。
claims.statement: Freiberger Compound Materials' own InP wafer specification page lists indium phosphide substrate wafers in 100 mm and 3-inch diameters, grown by VGF, with sulfur-doped n-type grades whose stated applications are LASER and Detector. Supplier self-report from an undated product page: it shows a commercial InP substrate product line, not its volume, share, capacity plans or data-center customers.
